Keep the local journal small, then verify the journal and record the budget. When the record looks wrong, trace the local index instead of the token.

When the scope looks wrong, validate the synthetic scope instead of the ledger. The small token only matters if the gate can rotate the router on its own.

The explicit budget only matters if the queue can gather the router on its own. Prefer a explicit token over a clever budget when you stage the record.
